instruction: Please enable the minimal view mode in VLC. I prefer a cleaner interface with fewer controls visible by default.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling minimal view mode in VLC (qt-minimal-view setting). The evaluator checks if qt-minimal-view is set to 1 (enabled) in the VLC configuration file. Similar UI customization task requiring VLC settings navigation.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_qt_minimal_view metric function. Expected value: qt-minimal-view=1 in vlcrc configuration file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC configuration file from OS-specific path (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc on Linux)
Metric function check_qt_minimal_view correctly parses config file and searches for qt-minimal-view setting
Expected value '1' correctly represents minimal view mode enabled, matching instruction requirement
Postconfig properly kills and relaunches VLC to ensure settings are persisted to disk before verification
Edge case handling: defaults to '0' if setting not found in config, which is correct VLC default behavior
Complete coverage: evaluator directly verifies the single requirement (enable minimal view mode)
Data flow is correct: VLC config file -> parse qt-minimal-view setting -> compare to '1'
